The company exhibits severe liquidity stress and highly leveraged balance sheet characteristics, evidenced by a critically low current ratio of 0.55 (current liabilities of $857M exceed current assets of $475M by a wide margin) and a high total liabilities-to-equity ratio of 2.53x ($7.24B in liabilities against $2.87B in equity). While the business remains operationally profitable with a decent 20% operating margin, the vast gap between operating income ($371M) and net income ($67M) suggests a heavy burden of non-operating expenses, likely driven by high interest expenses on its massive debt load. These factors indicate a highly speculative credit profile with elevated default risk in the near-to-medium term.

DECISION: B-
